root_cause.text: After an error in iris_kill_session frees inst_hfi_gen2->packet, a subsequent call to stop_streaming in iris_hfi_gen2_session_stop attempts to use the freed pointer, leading to a use-after-free crash.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "iris_kill_session ... calls session_close, which will kfree(inst_hfi_gen2->packet). If stop_streaming is called afterward, it will cause a crash." The patch adds a NULL check for inst_hfi_gen2->packet before proceeding with the STOP packet, confirming the missing sanity check as the root cause.
